description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners in the Evaluation Analysis area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners: Extracting Actionable Knowledge for Embodied Agents”. The page names Wenlong Huang, Deepak Pathak, Igor Mordatch as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
